title: Records Delete
content:
Older than 1 year
- JO
- JE 
- Activity Logs

Deleted Archive
- Archived records are automatically purged after 30 days.
- Staff profile images are also deleted when their archived staff record expires.

Notifications
- Notifications older than 30 days can be deleted through the notification cleanup action.

Manually deleted records
- Notes
- Products
- Product categories
- Suppliers
- Services
- Service bundles
- Staff records
- Estimates
- Job orders
- Expenses
- Manual income
- Announcements
- Notifications
